about_pullquote: I started this because I was tired of seeing customers ripped off by cowboys.
about_para_1: R Oliver Plumbing & Heating has been serving Coventry homes and businesses for over 20 years. What began as a one-man operation has grown into a trusted local name, built on honest pricing and work you can rely on. Every job — whether a £40 tap washer or a £4,000 boiler — gets the same care and attention to detail.
about_para_2: Our reputation is earned through fast response times, transparent quotes with no hidden charges, and customers who call us back year after year. We're Gas Safe registered, fully insured, and we stand behind every install with proper guarantees. If you're fed up ringing around only to be given vague estimates, you'll appreciate how we do things.
reviews_heading: What Coventry Homeowners Say About Us

reviews.text: Had a burst pipe under the kitchen at 11pm on a Sunday. Called R Oliver and he was here by midnight. Fixed it properly, cleaned up the mess, and didn't charge a fortune like some would. Legend. Will use him for everything from now on.
reviews.author: Marcus T.

reviews.text: Needed a new boiler before winter kicked in. Got a quote same day, installation booked within a week. The fitter was polite, professional, and finished on time. New system is quiet and heating is spot on. Can't fault them.
reviews.author: Patricia W.

reviews.text: Annual service on my boiler. Very thorough, explained what he was checking, and didn't try to sell me stuff I didn't need. That's rare. Fair price and peace of mind knowing it's safe for another year.
reviews.author: David P.
